caption:
ALREADY OUR NO. 2? 🎮🏀 Steph's the guy. Our second-best scorer is a rookie.

• Steph, 10 games: 27.8 PPG
• Yaxel Lendeborg, pick 11, 13 games: 20.2 PPG, 41.4% from three, 7.4 RPG
• Podz, 11 games: 16.5 PPG, just 1.2 turnovers a night
• The knock on Yaxel: 3.2 turnovers a night

Yaxel or Podz? 👇
